name: Walker uses corridors

actions.comment: Was a bare `goto /agents-flow` (which now redirects to /login or /setup) followed by `click text 'Demo Walk'`. There is no Demo Walk control any more — walkers are spawned by the office itself via sendWalker/sendWalkerToPoint when agents commute or head to a meeting, so there is no on-demand trigger left to click. The test therefore observes the live office instead of forcing a walk.

actions.value: (() => { const canvas = document.querySelector('.world3d-canvas canvas'); return canvas ? 'canvas found' : 'no canvas'; })()

expect: The 3D office renders with rooms and corridors visible
If a walker (small humanoid figure with glowing light) is present, it is in a corridor or doorway and NOT clipping through a room wall
No walker on screen is acceptable — walkers only spawn on agent commutes and meetings, and this test no longer forces one
